title: AI Personal Experiments
summary: A series of personal AI-driven cinematic experiments exploring memory, identity, Syria, and personal visual ideas through a more artistic and expressive approach rather than traditional commercial storytelling.
description:
A series of personal AI-driven cinematic experiments exploring memory, identity, Syria, and personal visual ideas through a more artistic and expressive approach rather than traditional commercial storytelling.

I developed each piece entirely from concept to final execution, including creative direction, visual development, AI production, editing, post-production, and final delivery.

Published on my personal Instagram, the videos collectively reached over 350,000 views, generating strong organic engagement and wider interest around the work.
